messages:
alejandra: quick heads-up: i'm opening a concise PR titled 'private/VPC migration quick-handoff' that bundles several small-but-common customer notes: MTU troubleshooting tips for sealed sites, a minimal PKCS#11 HSM config example, an sha256 checksum workflow for air-gapped bundles (with dos2unix caveat), a compact installer-vs-runtime port checklist, and a modern JS SDK proxy snippet. hoping for 1-2 reviewers.

mike: sounds good. please separate installer-only vs runtime port lists and mark ephemeral NAT note. customers often ask which port is strictly installer vs runtime.

alejandra: draft ports (compact): installer-only: 443 (downloads), 22 (ssh, optional), 2379 (etcd bootstrap), 30050-30060 (bootstrap helpers). runtime: 6443 (kube-apiserver), 10250 (kubelet), 50051 (internal rpc), 9100/9090 (metrics). note: egress NAT ephemeral ranges are required for external registries.

jin: current HSM vendor link in docs is 404. replacement: https://hsm-vendor.example.com/linux-pkcs11-guide — i'll paste that into the PR references. adding minimal pkcs11 example and a short troubleshooting checklist (ldd, selinux, perms).

emily: checksum flow ok. i'll validate the sha256 snippet on sealed-site-qa1 once PR is up. also add dos2unix note for windows-carriage returns that break verification.

alejandra: proposed checksum snippet for the appendix:

# build host
sha256sum redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz > redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256
# after transport to sealed site
dos2unix redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256 || true
sha256sum -c redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256

ops-tim: MTU note: we reproduced an etcd snapshot restore stall on a 1400 MTU path (snapshot ~80-120MB). symptom: slow chunk re-transmits and apparent hang during restore. repro: set MTU=1400 on both ends, run `etcdctl snapshot restore` with a 100MB snapshot and monitor tcp retransmits; kube-apiserver websocket clients also showed slow TLS handshakes until `--max-request-bytes` adjustments. i'll paste exact steps/logs into PR comments.

jin: PKCS#11 minimal config example to include:

# /etc/redwood/hsm.conf
pkcs11_library = /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so
slot_label = "redwood-hsm-slot"
pin = "****"
read_only = false

jin: troubleshooting bullets: - check `ldd /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so` for missing deps; - verify file perms and ownership; - `getenforce` to check SELinux; - run `strace -f -e open /usr/bin/redwood --hsm-test` to capture missing opens. keep each item short.

emily: JS SDK proxy snippet (avoid `rejectUnauthorized: false`):

// node fetch with proxy agent for sealed-site usage
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const HttpsProxyAgent = require('https-proxy-agent');
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent('http://proxy.local:3128');

await fetch('https://redwood.internal/api/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  agent,
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hello' })
});

emily: add a tiny note about DOCKER_BUILDKIT and setting NO_PROXY so build-time fetches do not bypass the offline proxy.

alejandra: great — plan: i'll open PR in ~20m with all items and tag @mike @jin. will attach ops-tim's MTU reproducer in comments.
